reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are more than most TikTok supplements show, and $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try on impulse. The money-back guarantee with nothing to send back makes it an easy one to test.
objection: A foil sachet for every single capsule is a lot of packaging waste for something I could just keep in a bottle. If I did not travel much I would not pay extra for that.
